title: Ryan: create the Anthus Slack app
description:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** Only Ryan can create the app under his Slack account. Slack's docs were checked for each item except where marked.

**Build.**
1. At api.slack.com/apps create an app from the manifest (kanbus-ae4094 writes `infra/slack/manifest.yaml` in Papyrus), named Anthus, with the Anthus icon.
2. Scope `chat:write`, no `chat:write.customize` (decision: no per-message override). `redirect_urls` lists each site's callback; the manifest allows up to 1000. No Events URL, per the plan's recommendation; if you would rather have uninstall events, a small endpoint goes in papyrus-monitoring.
3. Manage Distribution: complete the checklist and press Activate Public Distribution. Unlisted: OAuth install, no review, which Slack describes as suited to pilots.
4. Give Client ID and Client Secret to `scripts/put-channel-secrets.py` from your own shell; it writes shared SSM SecureStrings `/papyrus/shared/slack-*`. These values originate at Slack, so this is the one place a secret is entered by hand. Do not paste them into chat or Kanbus.
5. Later, not now: Slack Marketplace. Its guide calls apps unsuitable under 10 active workspaces and 20 monthly active users, and needs a public landing page, a privacy policy and a support page answering within 2 business days.

**Acceptance.**
Install on Anthus's own workspace; a test post.

**Depends on:** kanbus-a65828
